description:
Human issue lists, today printed by eight hand-written loops in six formats, go through one renderer in the output module.

## Background

The issue list is rendered inline in `crates/jit/src/main.rs` (or in the command group's handler module where it has moved) at: `run_query_all` (issue list, list, query all, bare query), `IssueCommands::Search`, `GraphCommands::Rdeps`, `GraphCommands::Roots`, and `QueryCommands::Available`, `Strategic`, `Closed` and `Blocked`. Each prints a command-specific header through `print_info` (suppressed by `-q`). Seven of eight indent rows by two spaces; `issue search` does not. Five print a `\nTotal: N` footer; search, rdeps and roots print none. Columns after `{id} | {title}` vary per command (state and priority, priority only, state only, or none), and blocked rows add indented `- {reason}` lines. Differences resolve to the form most sites print, and every command whose output changes gets a test.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One renderer in the output module takes the header, the rows, the per-command column set and optional per-row reason lines, and prints two-space-indented rows followed by a `Total: N` footer.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every command listed in the Background prints its issue list through that renderer and contains no row-printing loop of its own.
- [hard] REQ-03: `issue search` (indent and footer added) and `graph rdeps` and `graph roots` (footer added) have tests stating their new human output.
- [hard] REQ-04: One unit test owns the renderer's format; the other commands' human output is unchanged and their existing suites pass without weakened assertions.

## Notes

The `GraphCommands::Tree` view is a tree, not a list, and is out of scope. Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md`.
title: Render issue lists through one output renderer
